PUSHER_APP_ID.description: Server side only. Pusher states no sensitivity in prose; this follows where each credential appears in its own code samples.

PUSHER_KEY.description: Pusher's own browser examples pass this to the client constructor.

PUSHER_SECRET.description: Server side only. Rotating creates a new key and secret together; the app id and cluster do not change.

PUSHER_CLUSTER.description: A region such as eu or us2, passed to the browser client.
